curatedMovie.curiosityHook: As an era comes to a close, which loyalties will fracture first under the weight of an escalating underworld war?
curatedMovie.description: Against the momentous backdrop of Hong Kong's 1997 handover, a brutal power struggle ignites across the Triads, laying the deadly groundwork for the conflicts to follow.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: A tense, heavy crime thriller with deliberate momentum, delivering high-stakes suspense and gritty action.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Directors Andrew Lau and Alan Mak craft a gripping, heavy-hitting prequel where shifting alliances and underworld warfare collide with history.

facts.director: Andrew Lau Wai-Keung & Alan Mak Siu-Fai
facts.title: Infernal Affairs II
